plan.failureSummary: Cached replay step failed to locate age group radio buttons '[data-testid=\'radio-age-25-34\']' on the dynamic survey form.
observedIndicators: Failure occurred during replay of generated cache file .cache-lock/unstable-survey.test.ts.cache.js
Selector [data-testid='radio-age-25-34'] failed to resolve on live DOM
Failure screenshot shows different form fields (Occupation, What interests you?) following email input instead of age radio buttons
High historical pass rate (88.2%) with prior successful runs
isRetryAttempt is false and runMode is DETERMINISTIC

remediationSteps.summary: Clear Page.AI cache and re-run test
remediationSteps.details: Clear the Page.AI cache file for unstable-survey.test.ts and re-run the test to allow autonomous discovery and completion of the current survey questions.

remediationSteps.summary: Evaluate caching strategy for dynamic survey variations
remediationSteps.details: If the dynamic nature of the survey continues to cause cache drift, consider running in generative/autonomous mode or refining step instructions.

additionalDataRequests.description: Inspect live DOM structure of the survey form questions and their variation across renders.

plan.notes: The test uses Page.AI in DETERMINISTIC mode to complete a survey. The cached sequence expected an age group radio group after email input, but the live form currently displays 'Occupation' and 'What interests you?' fields instead. Because the failure occurred directly in the cache replay script and the overall objective is flexible ('Fill out the all of the survey questions with fake data...'), clearing the cache and allowing autonomous re-generation will resolve the issue.
